# Anthropic

> Anthropic develops Claude, a family of safe and capable AI assistants, while advancing AI safety research and responsible scaling practices.

Anthropic is an AI safety company focused on creating reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. The site showcases Claude models across different capability tiers, documents constitutional AI principles, and shares research on AI alignment, economic impact, and responsible development practices.

## Key Topics

- Claude
- Claude Opus 4.6
- Claude Sonnet 4.6
- Claude Haiku 4.5
- Constitutional AI
- AI Safety
- AI Alignment
- Claude API
- Prompt Caching
- Batch Processing
- Context Window
- Model Interpretability
- Responsible Scaling
- AI Policy
- Economic Impact

## Claude Models

- [Claude Opus 4.6](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus): Claude Opus 4.6 hybrid reasoning model with 1M context window
- [Claude Sonnet 4.6](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/sonnet): Claude Sonnet 4.6 hybrid reasoning model for agents and coding
- [Claude Haiku 4.5](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/haiku): Claude Haiku 4.5 cost-efficient model for agent tasks
- [Introducing Sonnet 4.6](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-4-6): Announcement of Claude Sonnet 4.6 with improved coding abilities

## AI Safety & Research

- [Research](https://www.anthropic.com/research): Anthropic's AI safety and research initiatives including alignment work
- [Claude's Constitution](https://www.anthropic.com/constitution): Constitutional AI framework defining Claude's values and behavior
- [Transparency Hub](https://www.anthropic.com/transparency): Safety evaluations and system cards for Claude model versions
- [Responsible Scaling Policy](https://www.anthropic.com/responsible-scaling-policy): AI safety governance and responsible scaling policy documentation
- [Economic Futures](https://www.anthropic.com/economic-futures): Research on AI's economic impact via Anthropic Economic Index
